verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no rule or trigger engine that runs actions automatically when events occur. The Watchlist only monitors expiry and status changes, which is adjacent alerting rather than event-triggered actions. The 120+ action API and the conversational MCP server are developer building blocks or on-demand tools, not user-defined automation rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
